found_values.value: Not found at the operating point. SLVSI72A gives efficiency curves only for VIN 5, 9, 12 and 20 V at VOUT 5, 9, 12 and 15 V (Figures 5-1 to 5-8). The nearest curve, Figure 5-3 (VOUT 9 V, VIN 5 V, FPWM), ends at about 4 A near 88 %. The average inductor current limit ILIM_AVG is 7 A minimum and 8 A typical, with no maximum (VIN 8 V, VOUT 15 V), and the peak limit is 13 A typical. In boost mode the input current is the inductor current. 53.3 W from 6.0 V needs 8.9 A even at 100 %, so the converter cannot deliver 8.4 V at 6.35 A from 6.0 V. R7 keeps the row's 90 % (9.9 A) as the upper bound of the servo supply's pack current.
found_values.source: TPS55285 data sheet SLVSI72A (April 2025, revised October 2025), sections 5.5 (CURRENT LIMIT) and 5.6, sections 6.3.9 and 6.3.12, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps55285.pdf

found_values.value: 1.68 A at 8.4 V: 15 W (F8) x 94 % (V139) / 8.4 V. The same 15 W gives 2.35 A at 6.0 V. The P26A allows 6.0 A maximum charge (2.6 A standard).

found_values.value: Yes. The BQ25713's NVDC power path starts the system with no battery or a depleted one and regulates VSYS to at least MinSystemVoltage, 6.144 V for 2S at power-on reset. The board then draws up to the USB-C input limit, 3.0 A at 5 V (15 W, F8), less the charge current. The servo supply's 53.3 W is not available from USB-C.
found_values.source: BQ25713 data sheet SLUSD83C, features ('Instant-on with no battery or depleted battery', 'Battery supplements system when adapter is fully-loaded') and MinSystemVoltage register (2S default 6.144 V); F8 answer, Research.md:536

found_values.value: Yes. F8 makes USB-C the only charge source, and a pack held off by the per-cell floor disconnect (F9) is recovered only by charging it. The charger therefore connects on the cells' side of R5's disconnect. With the BQ25713, the cells sit on the SRP/SRN sense resistor and the external BATFET, and R5's disconnect sits between VSYS and the board's loads.
found_values.source: F8 and F9 answers, Research.md:536-537 at commit e13f5f6; BQ25713 SLUSD83C application diagram

report.figure: pack current at the 6.0 V floor
report.value: 11.29 A plus loads not stated: 9.9 A servo supply (8.4 V x 6.35 A = 53.3 W at the row's assumed 90 %, V140 not found) + 1.39 A display (7.5 W at the row's assumed 90 %, V141 not found) + the 3.3 V logic, load-cell excitation, 5 V encoder and 12 V encoder supply (V143 not found). P5 recomputes it from R5's and R6's verified efficiencies
report.source: R7 row Research.md:285; IOBoard.md:326; V140, V141, V143 in this return

report.figure: TPS55285 input current bound from the pack
report.value: ILIM_AVG 7 A min, 8 A typ, no max (VIN 8 V, VOUT 15 V); peak inductor limit 13 A typ. In boost mode the input current is the inductor current, so from 6.0 V the converter draws at most about 8 A typ and cannot deliver 8.4 V at 6.35 A (53.3 W needs 8.9 A even at 100 %). No efficiency curve exists at 6.0 V in or 8.4 V out. For R6 (V110, V111, V132) and P5
Molicel INR-18650-P26A: Discharge Current Maximum 35 A, cycle-tested at 10 A and 20 A continuous; 23.7 A above the 11.29 A known pack current. INR-18650-M30A and M35A: 10 A, under it
P26A: charge 0 to 60 degC ambient, discharge -40 to 60 degC; both cover the 0 to 50 degC of V7

discharge overcurrent between 11.29 A plus unstated loads and 35 A; short circuit at no more than 35 A. MAX17320 with a 1 mOhm sense resistor: medium 2.5 to 77.5 A (1 to 15 ms), fast short circuit 5 to 155 A (70 to 985 us), slow 0 to 51.2 A (351 ms to 35 s). The threshold and the protection FETs are set once P5 closes the pack current
report.source: MAX17320 Rev 12 Discharging Protection Functionality, read 2026-09-29T09:49:58Z; V150

report.value: 8.4 V nominal (4.2 V a cell, cell data sheets); 8.358 to 8.442 V at the BQ25713's +/-0.5 % regulation. R5 (V92) and R6 (V131) take 8.442 V as the highest pack voltage
report.source: P26A v1.4; BQ25713 SLUSD83C features, read 2026-09-29T09:49:52Z

report.value: about 94 % at 2 A into 7.4 V (BQ25713 Figure 8-4, graph reading); the BQ25887 states 93.4 % at 5 V, 7.6 V and 1 A

report.figure: charge current from the 15 W source
report.value: 1.68 A into 8.4 V and 2.35 A into 6.0 V at 94 %; a charge at the 3 A limit draws 2.8 to 3.0 A from USB-C (IIN_HOST 0x3C00)

BQ25713 IIN_HOST with 10 mOhm RAC: 0x3C00 gives 2800 to 3000 mA, 0x1E00 1300 to 1500 mA, 0x0A00 300 to 500 mA. The ILIM_HIZ pin is +/-200 mA: 2.2 V gives 2800 to 3200 mA, 1.6 V 1300 to 1700 mA, 1.2 V 300 to 700 mA, so a pin setting overdraws a 3 A, 1.5 A or Default source unless it is set 200 mA low. IIN_HOST is 3.25 A at power-on reset

report.figure: external BATFET and battery sense resistor
report.value: not selected. The BATFET on /BATDRV carries at least 11.29 A continuous plus the unstated loads and survives the protection's short-circuit trip. At 10 mOhm the sense resistor drops 113 mV and dissipates 1.27 W at 11.29 A (SRP-SRN recommended within +/-0.5 V; charge regulation range 0 to 81.28 mV). A gap for a follow-up or round 2

The BQ25713 stops charging and resets ChargeCurrent to 0 when no MaxChargeVoltage or ChargeCurrent write arrives within 175 s (watchdog, adjustable or disabled in REG0x01[6:5]). A flat pack therefore charges only after the RP2354B runs from USB-C through VSYS (V152)

MAX17320: up to 100 mA a pin, set by external resistors, from NVM with no firmware. BQ76907: 0 to 50 mA a cell, host-controlled. BQ29209: up to 15 mA internal, automatic at 30 mV imbalance. BQ25887: up to 400 mA (dropped with its charger). No required figure found (V142)
report.source: MAX17320 Rev 12; SLUSE96A 6.3; SLUSA52C page 1; SLUSD89B

report.value: No S9 cell at Digi-Key (18 keyword searches, 1 product-details 404) or in the jlcparts copy; Mouser 403. The pack cells fail rule 4 until the owner names a vendor (V151)

tSinkAdj 60 ms maximum (from T1 P1-R7's reading of USB Type-C Release 2.5 Table 4-32) is not shown by any data sheet read. FUSB303B gives tPDDebounce 10 to 20 ms and no Rp-change-to-OUT1/OUT2 delay, and the BQ25713 ILIM_HIZ loop time is not stated. P5 or a bench measurement checks it

report.value: 500 mA: the shared connector carries D+/D- and CC1/CC2 only (5 lines, V13), no SuperSpeed pair, so the USB 3.2 figures of 900 and 1500 mA do not apply

The MAX17320 measures each cell and has a programmable undervoltage protect (nUVPrtTh) on its high-side DIS FET, so the pack protection R7 selects can serve as the 3.0 V floor disconnect of V98 option (b). Threshold tolerance over 0 to 50 degC not read
